blocks.text: Mobile POS puts customer sign-up, top-ups and bill payments on a dealer's or field agent's phone. Every sale lands in CRM and billing.

Operators selling through shops, dealers and door-to-door agents lose orders to paper forms and long sign-ups, and they can't track dealer sales and payments in one place. A **telecom POS** on the dealer's own phone fixes both.

head: Fact
Detail
rows: Alepo CRM and billing, plus inventory. Top-ups and voucher redemption.
In your environment, on Kubernetes, with 24x7 support

blocks.text: Also known as: mPOS, dealer app, agent app, field sales app, retailer app, point of sale

sections.h2: One record for every dealer sale

blocks.text: Every dealer sale creates one record across CRM, billing and inventory.
Sales and payments by dealer are tracked in one place.

sections.h2: Offers sold at the point of sale

blocks.text: Your dealers see current promotions at the point of sale. They top up a customer with an offer, or redeem a voucher on the customer's behalf.
Sign-up happens on the spot, without paper forms.
Dealers sign in under the same single sign-on as the rest of the stack, with their own roles.
It serves shops and dealer networks, plus door-to-door agents.

items.q: What does a telecom dealer app do?
items.a: It lets dealers and field agents sign up customers, sell top-ups and vouchers and take bill payments on a phone, with every sale recorded in the operator's systems.

items.q: Can we track sales by dealer?
items.a: Yes. Sales and payments by dealer are tracked in one place, across CRM, billing and inventory.
Through the same single sign-on as the rest of the Alepo stack, with roles for each dealer.

blocks.text: Your team installs Mobile POS in containers, one standard way, from the same automated guide as every Alepo product. Upgrades stay small.

When something needs fixing, the patch goes only to the component affected, with rollback ready, so your maintenance window stays short and nothing else has to be upgraded at the same time. Mobile POS runs on Kubernetes in your environment, operated by your team or by Alepo, with 24x7 support from GTAC.
The build you test and see demoed is the build that goes live.
Tell us what you run today. We'll show you the product on a case like yours.
